admission_rule: a protocol can replace the default path only after parser, handshake, true transport data plane, live traffic, benchmark, reload cleanup, and rollback evidence pass
cross_cutting_gates: Go fallback remains default until each protocol reaches true-dataplane-ready
active datapath mptcp, MagicNetwork, SO_MARK, tproxy, DNS, and UDP paths must be validated with protocol traffic
reload must close or reuse protocol transports and global caches without stale sessions
benchmarks must compare the Go default path and Rust true dataplane on matched corpora
dae-wing and daed integration remains deferred until daemon default readiness is re-opened
deferred_until_shared_transport: Trojan-Go shared transport and inner Shadowsocks
VLESS Vision with TLS or REALITY
Juicity QUIC/H3 and pinned certificate chain
AnyTLS session multiplexing and packet stream
REALITY, xHTTP H2/H3, gRPC, Meek, and Mux shared transport
